plain_text:
Karl Weber appears in 36 recordings across 8 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1944 to 1962. The credits here include performer, announcer, and narrator.

In this archive, you will hear Karl Weber most often in Cloak and Dagger, Inspector Thorne, X Minus One, Dimension X, Stroke of Fate, The Mysterious Traveler, Words at War, and Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar.

Characters credited here include Inspector Thorne.
